description: Environment management, script context inspection, and global state control.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns the currently active global environment table, if one has been set via `lje.env.set`. Returns nothing if no environment is set.

returns.description: The active environment table, or `nil` if none is set.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Sets the active global environment table. This environment is automatically applied to functions compiled via `lje.func.compile`. Replaces any previously set environment.

params.name: env
params.description: The table to use as the environment.

functions.name: current_script
functions.description: Returns the name of the currently executing LJE script, if any.

returns.description: The script name, or `nil` if no script is currently active.

functions.name: current_script_path
functions.description: Returns the full path of the currently executing LJE script, if any.

returns.description: The script path, or `nil` if no script is currently active.

functions.name: find_script_files
description: Searches for files matching `search_path` relative to the current script's directory. Returns `nil` if no script is active.
Supports wildcard patterns, so if you wanted to find all files in `detours/`, you would do `detours/*`.

params.name: search_path
params.description: A path pattern to search for, relative to the current script.

returns.description: An array of matching file path strings, or `nil` if no script is active.

functions.name: is_lua_involved
functions.description: Returns whether a Lua function is present in the call stack at or above the given frame offset.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to start checking from. Defaults to `1`.

returns.description: `true` if a Lua frame is involved at or above the offset.

functions.name: is_lje_involved
functions.description: Returns whether an LJE frame is present in the call stack, starting from `frame_offset` and searching up to `max_depth` frames.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to start checking from. Defaults to `1`.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Maximum number of frames to search. Defaults to `-1` (unlimited).

returns.description: `true` if an LJE frame is found within the search range.

functions.name: is_lje_frame
functions.description: Returns whether the frame at exactly `frame_offset` is an LJE frame.

params.name: frame_offset
params.description: The frame level to check. Defaults to `1`.

returns.description: `true` if the specified frame is an LJE frame.

functions.name: disable_metatables
functions.description: Globally disables metatable lookups. While disabled, `__index`, `__newindex`, and other metamethods will not be invoked. Re-enable with `lje.env.enable_metatables`.
functions.deprecated: Only here for compatibility - metatable remapping is automatic and does not require this function.

functions.name: enable_metatables
functions.description: Re-enables metatable lookups after they have been disabled.
functions.deprecated: Only here for compatibility - metatable remapping is automatic and does not require this function.

functions.name: save_random_state
functions.description:
Saves the current PRNG state. Use in combination with `lje.env.restore_random_state` to create a temporary branch of randomness that does not permanently affect the global PRNG sequence.

**Note:** Saving and immediately restoring erases all randomness that occurred in between — subsequent calls will produce the same sequence. To avoid this, only save/restore at most once per logical frame, or re-seed the PRNG manually afterward.
functions.deprecated: LJE now uses a independent PRNG instance, this is no longer necessary or recommended.

functions.name: restore_random_state
functions.description: Restores the PRNG state previously saved by `lje.env.save_random_state`.
functions.deprecated: LJE now uses a independent PRNG instance, this is no longer necessary or recommended.

functions.name: remap_metatable
functions.description: Replaces the metatable used for a given Lua type name with `replacement`. Affects all future metatable lookups for that type.

params.name: type_name
params.description: The name of the type whose metatable should be remapped.

functions.name: auth_metatable
functions.description: Marks a metatable as authorized, allowing it to bypass LJE's metatable access restrictions.

functions.name: show_special_frames
functions.description: Controls whether special (internal LJE) frames are visible in stack introspection. Useful when debugging inter-LJE interactions.

params.name: show
params.description: `true` to make special frames visible, `false` to hide them.
